title: Signed module dual of a chain complex
statement: For a commutative ring A in universe u and a natural-indexed chain complex K of A-modules in universe u [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology], define D_A(K)^q = Hom_A(K_q,A) for q≥0, with differential (-1)^(q+1) times precomposition by d_(q+1). Extend this cochain complex by zero to integer degrees. The square of its differential is zero.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext, signed finite free Hom computation; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BQZ

proof.text: Construct the Hom modules and their signed linear precomposition maps. Evaluate the composite on a functional and a vector: it is the product of the two signs times evaluation on two consecutive chain boundaries, hence zero. Form CochainComplex.of and extend along embeddingUpNat. This construction and square-zero identity are proved in Lean.
